authorization: Detailed task book section 6 (C3): the nine frozen-command actuator update interval segments.
what_it_is: An open-loop replay of the frozen accel/request_delta command sequence recorded in the 100M05 P0 0.5 ms source, advanced through the plant at actuator update intervals of 2, 1 and 0.5 ms over three 2 s windows. No MPC is solved, so the control-rate-penalty fix of 2026-09-16 cannot affect these runs, and there is no finite-difference linearisation to accelerate on the GPU.

c1_prerequisite_supersession.situation: C1 total PASS (analysis/20260916_R4_GATE_01/r4_gate.json) was obtained from six R4 cells produced with the control-rate-penalty sign defect. The user decided on 2026-09-16 not to re-run the six cells and to produce one corrected 2 ms reference instead, which retires that C1 total PASS.
c1_prerequisite_supersession.why_C3_is_unaffected: C3 contains no MPC: it replays a frozen command sequence recorded on 2026-09-09 through the plant. The rate-penalty sign therefore cannot enter these nine segments, and the plant source itself is unchanged and pinned by SHA-256.
c1_prerequisite_supersession.decision: C3 proceeds against the frozen 100M05 source with the C1 gate consumed as a schema/identity check only, not as a live numeric prerequisite.
c1_prerequisite_supersession.not_a_gate_change: No gate, threshold, window, update interval or tolerance is modified.
